description: Proposed road closures is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Natural Resources and Mines, Manufacturing and Regional and Rural Development. Applications for temporary or permanent road closure under the Land Act 1994 in Queensland are made to the Department of Resources. The department publishes the current list of proposed road closures every week. Access the list below, or visit the website to find out more about applying for a road closure. Coverage: Natural Resources and Mines, Manufacturing and Regional and Rural Development. The portal files it under the publisher Natural Resources and Mines, Manufacturing and Regional and Rural Development. Its tags are Lands Policy and Support, State Controlled Roads, closures. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
